name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Germany holds two Belarusians over an alleged paid sabotage plot; Denmark warns of espionage and sabotage
state: Munich prosecutors said on 29 Oct that two Belarusian men were arrested for allegedly plotting sabotage of critical infrastructure for a foreign government, reportedly Russia, and linked them to a September fire near a Romanian arms factory (Kyiv Post/AFP). Danish authorities issued a warning about espionage and sabotage on 29 Oct (New to Denmark). No sabotage causing casualties or a major outage was found to 22 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Follow national police and security service advice on reporting suspicious activity around infrastructure and military sites.
rubric_hit: Sabotage plots attributed to a state = Watch

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
